title: Modern Warfare 4 Wants 90 FPS to Be the New Recommended | VoltTech
description: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4's official PC specs target 90 FPS on RTX 3060 Ti-class hardware, add ray tracing to every mode, and support DLSS 4.5, FSR Redstone and XeSS 3.
